problem.title: Count the Number of Special Characters II

approaches.title: Per-letter state tracking
approaches.summary: Tracks each letter with a four-state machine to determine whether lowercase appears before uppercase and whether lowercase later invalidates it. Revision 2 replaces numeric flags and incremental counting with an enum and final state filtering while preserving the same strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a 26-element numeric state array to track each letter's ordering and increment or decrement the special-character count as needed.
Refactors the numeric states into a descriptive enum and counts letters ending in the valid state, preserving the same per-letter state-machine approach.
